slug: 2026-01-01 My Money, Your Name Challenges and Workarounds in ID-Required Mobile Money in East Africa

systems.tiers: national ID applicants and NIDA offices, introduced December 2022; local government offices issue a paper endorsement letter and hand over the printed ID

note: An interview study (July to August 2022) of mobile money under another person's ID; local government offices appear only as issuers of endorsement letters, short of paper forms and stamps, and nothing is said of their connection.
